subject: Re: Post-discovery: Next steps & 30-min intro — availability?
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@orbital.ai>, Priya Singh <priya@orbital.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 15:34:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: Next steps & 30-min intro — availability?

Hi Sam / Priya,

Thanks again for the time today — good conversation and helpful signal on latency and embedding costs. Quick recap so we're aligned before we lock the next session: 

- Pain we heard: slow batch inference for large document search, token cost on long-context chat, and a desire for predictable throughput during peak ETL windows.
- Primary use-case: customer support retrieval + summarization (latency SLO 150–200ms p50, cost target ~35% below current spend).
- Stakeholders to involve on next call: Product (Priya), Infra/Platform (someone from your SRE team), and the person owning budgets.

Next step: 30-minute product intro + light technical Q&A where we show a short demo of our deduped prefix caching and batching profile. I pulled three windows that fit our team availability — please pick any that work for you or propose alternatives: 

- Option A: Tue, Jun 24 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Option B: Wed, Jun 25 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT
- Option C: Thu, Jun 26 — 11:00–11:30 AM PT

If none of those work, you can pick a time on my calendar here: https://calendly.com/redwood/jordan-30min

Also: attaching a one-pager that highlights runtime/cost tradeoffs and an initial mutual action plan (MAP) to frame follow-ups. If you have a short sandbox or data sample you can share ahead of the session, we can tailor the demo to your dataset (scrubbed PII is fine).

Agenda (30m):
- 5m: quick objectives and stakeholders
- 10m: product demo (inference runtime + caching)
- 10m: tech Q&A (SRE questions + integration)
- 5m: next steps / mutual action plan cadence

Let me know who from your side will join and which slot you prefer.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: redwood-one-pager.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]
[Attachment: mutual-action-plan-orbital.xlsx (Excel, 45KB)]

From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@orbital.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@orbital.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 18:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: Next steps & 30-min intro — availability?

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. Both helpful.

Option B (Wed, Jun 25 2:00–2:30 PM PT) works best for us. Priya will join and I've asked our SRE lead (we'll confirm name tomorrow) to try to be on the call as well.

Quick asks before the demo: 
- Can you include a slide with expected token-cost delta when using prefix caching vs baseline for long transcripts?
- Do you have an eval notebook or sandbox we can run against a small set of our examples prior to the call?

We will aim to share a small set of representative transcripts (anonymized) by EOD Monday.

Thanks — Sam
Sam Torres
Head of Product | Orbital AI
sam.torres@orbital.ai | +1 (617) 555-0199

Prep checklist: 
- Karthik: can you add a slide with token-cost delta and a 2-slide breakdown of caching behavior (how prefix caching reduces tokens and expected p50 improvement)?
- Laura: please prep a compact demo script that uses their anonymized transcript example (Sam said they’ll send it by Monday). Aim for a 6–8 minute demo clip highlighting response-time improvements and the KV cache hit-rate.
- I'll update the MAP (attached) with the follow-up milestones and the HubSpot deal (HS-8372).

Once we have the transcripts, we can spin up a small sandbox — Karthik, ping infra for a 2-hour preview environment if they need one.

Thanks — Jordan
